notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has 2 or more +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic land card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When it enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor, Felidar Retreat and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Amulet of Vigor's trigger resolves, untapping the land.
Lotus Cobra's trigger resolves, adding {G}.
Felidar Retreat's trigger resolves, putting a +1/+1 counter on all creatures you control.
Repeat.
